format: 32 random bytes as 64 lowercase hex (secrets.token_hex in keychain-prod.py)

flow.source: macOS Keychain arma2-torneos-prod-core-contract/contract-secret (generated once, 32 random bytes as hex, inside keychain-prod.py; never regenerated silently)
destinations_allowed: Core Production (rcyuuoaqfwcembdajcss) Edge secret TORNEOS_CONTRACT_SERVICE_SECRET — this tooling
Deno Deploy app torneos-gateway, variable TORNEOS_CONTRACT_SERVICE_SECRET — a LATER phase, not this tooling
carriers: node memory → HTTPS body of POST /v1/projects/{prod}/secrets
node memory → HMAC key of the signed harness

state_machine.ABSENT/absent: generate once (after the phrase, before the first remote write) → set on Core
state_machine.PRESENT/PRESENT (contract installed): verify by signed probe; mismatch → STOP (no reconcile)

guarantees: value never printed, logged, in argv, env or files
no add of an external value → Staging cannot be copied in
Production value compared in memory with the nonprod entry: equal → STOP
no -U, no delete, no rotation implemented (rotation needs its own authorized procedure)
evidence gate: known secrets + sbp_/sb_secret_/JWT/connection-string patterns → refused
